johnrant21: Nobody asked Clement "Lucky" Johnrant why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Drowned Farm. Isidor Lowelleast fired; Clement "Lucky" Johnrant pulled the bucket down. A sign later appeared: 'Water costs enough already.'
lettersabcd: Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd told the sergeant he was a dance-hall violinist. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
First Wave. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a frozen apple.
virajvirxgill13: Nobody saw Jakub Virajvirxgil arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F16, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Lightning lit the Chalk Pits and Jakub Virajvirxgil saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back.
